messages.author: cd24c23b205ce60b
messages.subject: submit button, with isolate.
parts:
Hi, I'm trying to implement a form to upload a file, but start to do operation when I click on a submit button, the problem is that a have a strange mistake and I don't know what's it, I made the example of the tutorial and it worked without problem, now I'm implementing the same but with index.html and it don't work. 

The mistake is:
"Error in if (input$uploadFasta == 0) return(NULL) : 
  argument is of length zero"

my index.html is like:

         <form class="span12 menu-med-upload">
            <div class="row-fluid">
                <center>
                  <div class="custom-input-file btn btn-inverse">
                    <input type="file" size="1" id="fileFasta" class="input-file" />
                  </div>
                </center>
                <button id="uploadFasta" type="button" class="btn action-button shiny-bound-input" >go!</button>
            </div>
          </form>

my server.R is like:

output$table <- renderText({
    if(input$uploadFasta == 0)
      return(NULL)
    myRenderTable()
  })

somebody know what's the problem, and thank for all and sorry if this topic was open before but I could not find.

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: submit button, with isolate.
parts:
I'm not sure if this will fix your issue, but it's worth trying. This is the output of actionButton('uploadFast', 'go!'), which is slightly different from what you have in your HTML:
<button id="uploadFasta" type="button" class="btn action-button">go!</button>

In your HTML, you also added the shiny-bound-input class, but this class is normally added by Shiny after loading the page.


If you're using Chrome, the HTML you want to copy is from "View Source". If you use "Inspect Element", it'll show you the dynamic state of the DOM, but what you want is the starting HTML, which is what View Source shows you.

-Winston
